$comment: Hearst Connect — dashboard vision layout map. Concept only; no application file implements this. Every 'dataState' describes what the element would show TODAY against the real backend, not what the mockup renders (the mockup renders fixture data throughout).
product: Hearst Connect — admin vault operations console

dataStateLegend.FIXTURE: Rendered from invented values in the mockup; a real source exists or is derivable
dataStateLegend.NAMED_ABSENCE: Would render as an explicit 'Unavailable' with its endpoint — never as zero
dataStateLegend.NEEDS_HISTORY: Requires time-series storage that does not exist yet

elements.function: Two groups — Operate (Home, Vaults, Clients, Compliance, Operations) and System (Runtime, API Explorer, Administration). Counters only where they mean work waiting or coverage.
elements.sourceNote: Five-entry rail exists in src/lib/admin-nav.ts; 'Vaults' promoted to primary is PROPOSED
elements.desktop: Persistent 248px rail, icons + labels, active item accent-tinted, identity and OWNER badge at foot
elements.mobile: Replaced by a 5-item bottom tab bar (Home, Vaults, Clients, Moves, System) with an alert badge on Clients

elements.function: Names the screen and the estate scope: vault count, chain, and where readings come from
elements.mobile: Compact H1 with wordmark tile, subtitle reduced to '7 vaults · Base · read 12:41 UTC'

elements.function: Indexer lag and last-read timestamp — tells the user how old the whole screen is
elements.sourceNote: runtime endpoint reports indexer lag; asOf carried on every Availability
elements.desktop: Two chips: 'Indexer lag 14 s', 'Last read 12:41:08 UTC'

elements.function: Marks every figure on screen as invented — CONCEPT · FIXTURE DATA
elements.sourceNote: Required by the mission brief for this concept; not a product feature
elements.desktop: Warning-toned chip in the header + full disclaimer line in the footer
elements.mobile: Full-width chip under the header + short footer line

How many pockets breach the ±200 bps tolerance right now, out of the total

elements.function: Clients that cannot proceed, split by cause (compliance / no vault assigned)

elements.desktop: Figure in warning tone; today would render 'Unavailable' with its endpoint, never 0
elements.mobile: Folded into the 'Needs a decision' count

elements.function: Net capital movement over 30 days, with deposit and redemption counts
elements.sourceNote: P5 — aggregation over series1-events, which exists
elements.desktop: Figure plus a 12-bar mini histogram coloured by direction

elements.function: DOMINANT VISUAL. Answers: is any pocket outside tolerance, and is it converging or running away? 30 days, basis points from target, 3 named series plus an aggregate band, ±200 bps thresholds, breach markers, hatched no-data column.
elements.sourceNote: P1 — current drift is readable; its history is not stored anywhere
elements.desktop: Full-width panel, ~46% of the content height, legend with units, period, provenance tag, and the stated-convention disclaimer
elements.mobile: Simplified to a single series (worst pocket), thresholds and tolerance band kept, legend and period kept, ~92px tall

elements.function: Ranked work queue — each row carries title, cause with duration and dollar impact, and a named resolution action. Ranked by capital at stake.
elements.sourceNote: P2 — composed from EXISTING readings (drift, exceptions, idle capital); the ranking and the merge are new
elements.desktop: 6 rows, severity bar on the left edge (danger / warning / info), action link on the right
elements.mobile: Promoted to the top of the screen, reduced to the 3 urgent items, rows ≥62px for thumb targets, chevron affordance

elements.function: One row per vault: status, value, deployed share, capacity headroom, NAV per share, worst pocket drift, last activity
elements.sourceNote: Vault type fully models these; /admin/vaults renders them today

elements.mobile: Dropped — reachable via the Vaults tab

elements.function: Latest indexed Series 1 movements with amount and age
elements.desktop: 4 rows, borderless, sharing a panel with source health
